newsitem.title: USA: Unemployment steady at 5.3 percent in December.
newsitem.headline: Unemployment steady at 5.3 percent in December.

text.p: The unemployment rate held steady at 5.3 percent in December as the economy created new jobs in most major industries, the government said on Friday.

The Labor Department said the jobless rate was unchanged last month after November's rate was revised downward to 5.3 percent from an earlier reported 5.4 percent. The department said 262,000 jobs were created outside the farm sector in December after a revised jump of 127,000 in November.
